text: [polite] Good day. You buy things here?
[amused] Ah, come on, meet me halfway.

[calm, polite] Eduard Lvovich. I look after the street. Small fee, monthly. Fires happen, you know.
[softly] Last month you said no. This month I am asking you properly.
[quiet, very calm] Three months. Back pay. Or we stop being polite.
[dry] Detective Volkova. Just a courtesy call. Keep your book tidy and we’ll get along.
[flat] I’m looking for a bracelet. Gold, a chipped clasp. You’ve seen it?
[cold] Put that away before I write it down.
[easygoing] Venya. From the bridge. Tuesdays, remember? It’s not Tuesday. I’m flexible.
[sleepy, cheerful] Quiet night on the river. Well. [short pause] Mostly quiet.
[sore] Another no. It’s all going in the notebook, you know.
[enthusiastic] From a friend in Dubai! Real, one hundred percent. Look at the weight!
[laughs nervously] Okay, okay… maybe ninety percent.
[serious for once] This one is real. Ramil’s. Please look properly.
[warm, old] Good day. You’re the new one? The old one used to shout.
[wry] My mother’s earrings. I never wear them now. My ears have given up.
[chuckles] His ring. It doesn’t fit anyone in the family. They have fat fingers, all of them.
